name: Yeast glycolysis (Teusink 2000) as a black box

provenance.ref: Teusink et al. 2000 Eur J Biochem

notes: OPEN by construction: this is a PARTIAL 2-port projection (glucose in, pyruvate out) of the full glycolysis model. Glucose (C6H12O6) -> 2 pyruvate (C6H6O6) leaves 6 H that go to the balancing intracellular species (H+, H2O, NAD(H), ATP/ADP, Pi) -- which are NOT medium ports. So the box exchanges those atoms with an unmodelled intracellular compartment, exactly the open-boundary case; its declared net flux is the boundary. (An expert would flag the alternative -- exposing ATP/NADH in a shared extracellular medium -- as wrong.)

validity.note: kinetic model; unit compartment assumed (amount~conc) -- v0.1 schema TODO
